The '''''Rathtar's Revenge''''' was a massive [[starship]] used as the [[flagship]] of the [[pirate]] group [[Ganguls]].<ref name="Hotshot">{{YJA|Heroes and Hotshots}}</ref> The starship took part during the [[Battle of Tenoo]] where it attempted to destroy the [[Tenoo Jedi Temple]] with cables. However, the ship was shot down by [[Taborr's gang]], [[Inaya]] of Hazun, [[Durangos]] and [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Wes Vinik]]. The Ganguls were captured by the Jedi while their remaining allies fled.<ref name="Battle of Tenoo">{{YJA|The Battle of Tenoo}}</ref>
